UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific data, overall progress, and relationships with other users and game elements.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: User's chosen display name, visible on dashboards and leaderboards.

email.description: User's email address, primarily used for authentication (assuming an external auth system manages passwords).

overallSkillLevel.description: Overall skill level of the user (e.g., 'Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced').

xpPoints.description: Total experience points accumulated by the user.

totalScore.description: Total score achieved by the user across all games and courses.

streaks.description: Number of consecutive days the user has been active or completed a task.

lastActiveAt.description: Timestamp of the user's last activity, used for streak calculation.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

friendIds.description: References to other UserProfile entities that are friends with this user. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N UserProfile)

outgoingFriendRequestIds.description: References to FriendRequest entities initiated by this user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FriendRequest)

incomingFriendRequestIds.description: References to FriendRequest entities received by this user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FriendRequest)

userCourseProgressIds.description: References to UserCourseProgress entities tracking this user's progress in various courses. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserCourseProgress)

gameAttemptIds.description: References to GameAttempt entities representing this user's attempts in games. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N GameAttempt)

userAchievementIds.description: References to UserAchievement entities for achievements earned by this user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserAchievement)

userBadgeIds.description: References to UserBadge entities for badges earned by this user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserBadge)

certificateIds.description: References to Certificate entities earned by this user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Certificate)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Course.title: Course
Course.description: Represents a distinct programming language learning course (e.g., Python Fundamentals).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Course entity.

name.description: The name of the course (e.g., 'Python Fundamentals').

description.description: A brief description of the course content.

language.description: The programming language associated with this course (e.g., 'Python', 'Java').

levelIds.description: References to Level entities belonging to this course, in their progressive order. (Relationship: Course 1:N Level)

totalLevels.description: Total number of levels in this course.

imageUrl.description: URL to an image representing the course (e.g., a course thumbnail).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the course was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the course was last updated.

Level.title: Level
Level.description: Represents a specific learning stage or module within a Course.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Level entity.

courseId.description: Reference to the Course this level belongs to. (Relationship: Course 1:N Level)

title.description: The title of the level (e.g., 'Variables and Data Types').

description.description: A brief description of the level's content and learning objectives.

orderIndex.description: The sequential order of this level within its course.

difficulty.description: The difficulty rating of the level (e.g., 'Easy', 'Medium', 'Hard', 'Boss').

gameIds.description: References to Game entities included in this level. (Relationship: Level 1:N Game)

requiredXpToUnlock.description: Experience points required to unlock this level. Can be 0 if no unlock requirement.

prerequisiteLevelId.description: Reference to a Level entity that must be completed before this level can be accessed. (Optional, if progression is strictly linear by orderIndex).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the level was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the level was last updated.

Game.title: Game
Game.description: Represents an interactive game or exercise within a Level.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Game entity.

levelId.description: Reference to the Level this game belongs to. (Relationship: Level 1:N Game)

title.description: The title of the game or exercise.

description.description: A brief description of the game's objective.

questionContent.description: The main content of the game, such as question text, code snippet, or visual scenario description.

options.description: A list of options for games like MCQs or draggable code blocks.

correctAnswer.description: The correct answer for the game. Format depends on 'type' (e.g., option ID, filled text, ordered blocks).

expectedOutput.description: The expected output for 'CodeSimulator' type games.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum number of attempts allowed for this game.

xpReward.description: Experience points awarded for successfully completing this game.

hintIds.description: References to Hint entities available for this game. (Relationship: Game 1:N Hint)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the game was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the game was last updated.

GameAttempt.title: GameAttempt
GameAttempt.description: Records a single attempt by a user on a specific game.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GameAttempt entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who made this attempt. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N GameAttempt)

gameId.description: Reference to the Game that was attempted. (Relationship: Game 1:N GameAttempt)

courseId.description: Reference to the Course the game belongs to, for contextual reporting. (Relationship: Course 1:N GameAttempt)

levelId.description: Reference to the Level the game belongs to, for contextual reporting. (Relationship: Level 1:N GameAttempt)

attemptNumber.description: The sequential number of this attempt for the given game by the user.

userInput.description: The input provided by the user during this attempt (e.g., chosen option, written code).

isCorrect.description: Indicates whether the user's attempt was correct.

scoreAchieved.description: Score obtained in this specific attempt.

xpEarned.description: Experience points earned in this specific attempt.

hintsUsedCount.description: Number of hints used during this attempt.

timeTakenSeconds.description: Time taken by the user to complete this attempt in seconds.

attemptedAt.description: Timestamp when this game attempt was made.

Achievement.title: Achievement
Achievement.description: Defines a specific accomplishment or milestone a user can earn.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Achievement entity.

name.description: The name of the achievement (e.g., 'First Code', 'Python Master').

description.description: A description detailing how to earn the achievement.

criteria.description: Programmatic criteria for unlocking the achievement (e.g., 'Complete 1st game', 'Login 10 consecutive days').

imageUrl.description: URL to the icon or image representing the achievement.

xpBonus.description: Bonus experience points awarded upon earning this achievement.

isSecret.description: Indicates if the achievement is hidden until earned.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the achievement definition was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the achievement definition was last updated.

UserAchievement.title: UserAchievement
UserAchievement.description: Records that a specific user has earned a specific achievement. This is a junction entity for the N:N relationship between UserProfile and Achievement.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserAchievement entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who earned the achievement. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Achievement)

achievementId.description: Reference to the Achievement definition that was earned. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Achievement)

achievedAt.description: Timestamp when the achievement was earned by the user.

Badge.title: Badge
Badge.description: Defines a visual award or recognition a user can earn, often tied to specific in-game actions or progress.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Badge entity.

name.description: The name of the badge (e.g., 'C++ Rookie', 'Bug Squasher').

description.description: A description detailing the criteria for earning the badge.

criteria.description: Programmatic criteria for unlocking the badge (e.g., 'Complete 5 C++ games', 'Solve 10 bugs').

imageUrl.description: URL to the image representing the badge.

rarity.description: The rarity level of the badge (e.g., 'Common', 'Rare', 'Epic').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the badge definition was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the badge definition was last updated.

UserBadge.title: UserBadge
UserBadge.description: Records that a specific user has earned a specific badge. This is a junction entity for the N:N relationship between UserProfile and Badge.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserBadge entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who earned the badge. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Badge)

badgeId.description: Reference to the Badge definition that was earned. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Badge)

earnedAt.description: Timestamp when the badge was earned by the user.

Certificate.title: Certificate
Certificate.description: Stores details of a generated certificate awarded to a user upon course completion.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Certificate entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who earned this certificate. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Certificate)

courseId.description: Reference to the Course for which this certificate was issued. (Relationship: Course 1:N Certificate)

certificateUrl.description: URL to the downloadable PDF or image file of the certificate.

courseName.description: The name of the course as it appears on the certificate (denormalized for persistence).

studentName.description: The name of the student as it appears on the certificate (denormalized for persistence).

completionDate.description: The date when the course was officially completed and the certificate earned.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the certificate record was generated.

Hint.title: Hint
Hint.description: Stores definitions for hints available for games, providing assistance to users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Hint entity.

gameId.description: Reference to the Game this hint is for. (Relationship: Game 1:N Hint)

orderIndex.description: The sequential order of this hint within the available hints for a game.

hintText.description: The textual content of the hint.

hintContent.description: Additional content for the hint, such as a code example or an image URL for visual hints.

difficultyLevelApplicable.description: Indicates the user's skill level this hint is most applicable to (e.g., 'Beginner', 'Intermediate').

requiredFailedAttempts.description: Minimum number of failed attempts before this hint becomes available.

xpCost.description: Experience points deducted from the user for using this hint.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the hint was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the hint was last updated.

FriendRequest.title: FriendRequest
FriendRequest.description: Manages requests from one user to another to establish a friendship.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FriendRequest entity.

senderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent the friend request. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FriendRequest)

receiverId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who is the recipient of the friend request. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FriendRequest)

status.description: The current status of the friend request (e.g., 'pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'cancelled').

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the friend request was sent.

respondedAt.description: Timestamp when the friend request was accepted, rejected, or cancelled. Null if status is 'pending'.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the friend request record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the friend request record was last updated.

UserCourseProgress.title: UserCourseProgress
UserCourseProgress.description: Tracks a user's progress within a specific course.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserCourseProgress entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile making progress in the course. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserCourseProgress)

courseId.description: Reference to the Course being taken by the user. (Relationship: Course 1:N UserCourseProgress)

currentLevelId.description: Reference to the highest Level the user has reached or is currently active in within this course. (Relationship: Level 1:N UserCourseProgress)

completedLevelIds.description: An array of Level IDs that the user has successfully completed in this course. (Relationship: UserCourseProgress 1:N Level)

progressPercentage.description: The calculated percentage of the course completed by the user (0-100).

xpEarnedInCourse.description: Total XP earned by the user specifically within this course.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the user has fully completed this course.

startedAt.description: Timestamp when the user started this course.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the user completed this course. Null if not completed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the course progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the course progress record was last updated.

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. Access is restricted to the authenticated user whose UID matches the userId in the path. This collection serves as the root for all user-specific subcollections.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, corresponding to Firebase Authentication UID. Used for path-based ownership.

params.description: The unique identifier for a specific game attempt.

params.name: userAchievementId

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who earned the badge.

params.name: userBadgeId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific user badge record.

definition.description: Stores certificates earned by a specific user. Documents include denormalized 'userId' and 'courseId'. Access is read-only for the owner ('userId' in path and document).

params.name: certificateId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific certificate.

definition.description: Tracks a user's progress within a specific course. Documents include denormalized 'userId' and 'courseId'. Access is restricted to the owner specified by 'userId' in the path and document.

params.name: userId

params.name: userCourseProgressId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific user's course progress record.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed following the core principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling, ensuring a secure, scalable, and debuggable system for Code Conqueror. 

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):**
This design meticulously avoids hierarchical authorization dependencies by denormalizing authorization-relevant fields directly into the documents. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules, allowing for atomic operations and simplifying rule logic. For instance:
*   **User-Owned Data:** For entities like `GameAttempt`, `UserAchievement`, `UserBadge`, `Certificate`, and `UserCourseProgress`, the `userId` is included in the document's path (`/users/{userId}/...`) AND explicitly stored within the document itself (`resource.data.userId`). This allows rules to simply check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId` (for read/write within subcollections) or `request.auth.uid == userId` (for operations on the parent `UserProfile` document), without needing to fetch any parent document.
*   **Collaborative Data (FriendRequest):** The `FriendRequest` entity is stored in a top-level collection (`/friendRequests/{friendRequestId}`). Each `FriendRequest` document contains both `senderId` and `receiverId`. Authorization rules can directly check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.senderId || request.auth.uid == resource.data.receiverId`, making it completely independent of any other document.
*   **Public Definitions:** For `Course`, `Level`, `Game`, and `Hint` definitions, which are primarily public (read-only for all authenticated users), key parent IDs (`courseId`, `levelId`, `gameId`) are denormalized into their respective child documents. While these are less critical for 'public read' access rules, this denormalization ensures consistency and enables more granular, authorization-independent rules if specific write permissions (e.g., admin updates) are based on the document's context.

**Querying for All Permissions (QAPs):**
The structural segregation and denormalization directly support QAPs, ensuring that security rules are not used as data filters, and `list` operations remain secure and efficient:
*   **User-Specific Subcollections:** For all user-owned data (e.g., `/users/{userId}/gameAttempts`, `/users/{userId}/certificates`), `list` operations are inherently QAP-compliant because users can only query their *own* subcollections. The rule `allow list: if request.auth.uid == userId;` (where `userId` is the path wildcard) is sufficient, and every document returned by such a query will satisfy it.
*   **Global Public Collections:** Collections like `/courses`, `/achievements`, `/badges` are public read-only. `allow read: if request.auth.uid != null;` is QAP-compliant as any authenticated user can read all documents. Write access would typically be restricted to an administrator role (e.g., checking existence in a `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection), which is also QAP-compliant.
*   **FriendRequest (Collaborative):** For the `/friendRequests` collection, users will explicitly query for requests where they are either the `senderId` or `receiverId` (e.g., `db.collection('friendRequests').where('senderId', '==', request.auth.uid)` or `db.collection('friendRequests').where('receiverId', '==', request.auth.uid)`). The security rule `allow list: if request.auth.uid == request.query.where.senderId || request.auth.uid == request.query.where.receiverId;` can be crafted to ensure that any `list` operation must include one of these specific filters, making it QAP-compliant. This explicitly prevents a user from listing all friend requests in the database.

**Structural Segregation:**
*   Public definitions (`Course`, `Level`, `Game`, `Hint`, `Achievement`, `Badge`) are in top-level collections or subcollections that reflect their immutable, global nature, sharing a 'public read' security posture.
*   User-specific mutable data (`UserProfile`, `GameAttempt`, `UserAchievement`, `UserBadge`, `Certificate`, `UserCourseProgress`) is strictly organized under `/users/{userId}/...`, ensuring that individual user data is kept private and accessible only by its owner.
*   `FriendRequest` is a distinct entity with a unique collaborative access pattern, warranting its own top-level collection.

This architecture simplifies security rules, enhances debuggability, and provides a robust foundation for the Code Conqueror application.
